name: tpl-responded-existence-2-goal
task: If you move the ball, you must also take the key. Then pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The clauses match the task. The 'if you move the ball, you must also take the key' condition is RespondedExistence(blocker_moved, has_door_key) hard (no timing cue; it is a stated rule, so it stays despite being implied by the other clauses). 'Then pick up the box' gives a hard Existence(target_picked_up); per the follow-on rule the box must come after the key (Precedence(has_door_key, target_picked_up)) and after the ball move when it happens (Response(blocker_moved, target_picked_up)), both hard. Priorities are all hard with no preference cues, and all propositions are grounded in the environment.

texts: If the ball is moved, the matching door key must also be taken at some point.
Take the matching key before picking up the target box.
If the ball is moved, pick up the target box afterward.
